description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeMembershipAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides REST API endpoints for managing employee membership data, including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion of employee memberships. The class extends Endpoint and implements CrudEndpoint, utilizing various validation rules, request handling, and service layers to perform its operations.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller providing CRUD endpoints for employee membership management, including GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE operations with appropriate validation and service layer interactions.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of EmployeeMembershipService used to perform business logic related to employee memberships.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeMembership record by employee number and membership ID, returning a formatted API response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne() method, ensuring parameters are valid.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of EmployeeMemberships for a given employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employee memberships, including access rights and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EmployeeMembership record based on request data, returning the newly created object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Specifies validation rules for creating an employee membership, including required fields.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules applicable to both creation and updating of EmployeeMembership records.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing EmployeeMembership record identified by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an employee membership.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple EmployeeMembership records based on provided IDs for a specific employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Handles the logic for creating or updating an EmployeeMembership entity based on request parameters, including fetching existing records and setting properties.
